course_position.stage_name: Consolidation, Fluency, Confidence, and Integrated Review

lesson_intent.one_sentence_goal: Review subordinate clauses for reasons, conditions, and exceptions in one practical decision.
lesson_intent.real_life_context: Two adults decide whether to keep, cancel, or change a healthcare appointment.
lesson_intent.communicative_function: Explaining a decision with conditions and exceptions without losing sentence control.

dialogue_task.scenario: Anna and Erik discuss whether an appointment at the vårdcentral should be kept or moved because symptoms have changed and transport is uncertain.

main_focus.name: subordinate clauses with eftersom, om, när, and fast
main_focus.description: Use practical subordinate clauses to give a reason, condition, time reference, or mild contrast.
model_examples: Eftersom febern är borta kanske du kan vänta.
Om hostan blir värre behöver du ringa igen.
main_focus.desired_presence: Use 4-5 subordinate clauses naturally, with clear main-clause word order around them.

allowed_supporting_grammar: present tense and future with ska
avoid_grammar: advanced relative clauses as the main focus
too many symptoms or treatment options

useful_chunks: Det är bättre att vara på den säkra sidan.
vocabulary_target.desired_presence: Use practical health words without turning the scene into medical advice.

dialogue_shape.opening: One speaker says the symptoms have changed and asks whether the appointment is still needed.
dialogue_shape.middle: They weigh reasons to keep the time against conditions for cancelling or rebooking.
dialogue_shape.ending: They choose a cautious plan and define what would change the decision.

target_complexity.repetition: include varied subordinate clauses but keep each sentence easy to follow

focus: the condition that would change the plan
the reason a cautious option is preferred

sentence_focus: one sentence with eftersom explaining a reason
one sentence with om describing a condition
one sentence with när and correct V2 in the main clause
one sentence with fast showing a mild contrast
one sentence about booking or cancelling the appointment
